briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent AGI capabilities amid regulatory scrutiny

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate discussions as multi-agent systems proliferate. Global investment remains robust despite emerging regulatory hurdles.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with enhanced agent orchestration. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. xAI ships Grok-4 and DeepSeek launches R2 surpassing prior benchmarks in code and math.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act amendments target agentic behaviors.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to Microsoft and Google. TSMC ramps 2nm production for custom ASICs. Oracle announces $40B AI data center expansion across three continents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before the first uncontrolled recursive self-improvement event?
